study_label: EXTERNAL CROSS-SECTIONAL ROBUSTNESS STUDY (current-listing universe, retrospective)
scope: Does the CMF20 price/volume flow PROXY finding from FLOW 1B survive on symbols that were NOT used to discover it? Validation only; no production implementation regardless of outcome.
terminology_rule: CMF20/CMFScore are PRICE/VOLUME FLOW PROXIES, never actual money inflow/outflow.

discovery_reference.flow_1b_status: FULLY OBSERVED. Not an independent validation set. Not reused in FLOW 1C.

technical_blinding.mode: TECHNICAL_BLIND (carried over from FLOW 1B, user decision)
permitted: differences between CMF groups INSIDE the Technical-positive condition

universe.rule: external = BIST TÜM members from the official KAP index-constituents PDF (https://www.kap.org.tr/tr/api/company/indices/pdf/endeksler, retrieved 2026-09-23T08:57:42Z, pdf sha256 95350b7b...) minus the FLOW 1B frozen 100 symbols.
universe.no_other_symbol_filters: No symbol is added or removed based on returns, liquidity, sector or data appearance. The only data-driven exclusions are mechanical and counted: Yahoo fetch failure, and observation-level eligibility (calendar/integrity/continuity/warm-up rules identical to FLOW 1B).
universe.official_tum_minus_100_note: The official 'BIST TÜM-100' PDF section is not used because its extracted text is truncated (458 of 484; missing V–Z tail).
universe.survivorship: Current-listing universe applied backwards: historical-membership / listing survivorship bias REMAINS. FLOW 1C provides EXTERNAL CROSS-SECTIONAL robustness only; it does NOT solve survivorship.

data.provider: BistProvider (Yahoo Finance, yfinance history default auto_adjust=True), same as FLOW 1B
data.benchmark: XU100, frozen again in the same snapshot
data.validation_period_note: Same calendar period as FLOW 1B but disjoint symbols. Common market-wide shocks are shared with the discovery sample; this is cross-sectional, not temporal, out-of-sample evidence.
data.raw_storage: LOCAL ONLY at app/research/flow_v1c/data/frozen_ohlcv.json.gz (git-ignored, docker-ignored). Manifest + per-symbol content_sha256 + dataset_sha256 are version-controlled.
data.fetch_once_rule: Fetched once; the study verifies every hash and never contacts Yahoo.

preprocessing: Identical to FLOW 1B (completed bars, authoritative calendar normalization, per-row integrity, contiguous segments, 60-session warm-up, no fills).

candidate.CMF20: FLOW 1B definition unchanged (window 20; H==L bars excluded from numerator and denominator; unavailable -> NaN).
candidate.CMFScore: 100 * clamp(CMF20 / 0.25, -1, +1). Scale 0.25 = existing FLOW 1B research scale, NOT tuned.
candidate.negative_filter: CMFScore <= -20  (equivalently CMF20 <= -0.05). The exact boundary value -20 is REJECTED (<=).

targets.primary: Close(T) -> Close(T+10) stock return minus XU100 return over the same dates (information target, FLOW 1B definition).

P1.statement: CMF20 carries positive T+10 information beyond the Technical score.
P1.metric: mean over dates of the cross-sectional rank semi-partial IC of CMF20 controlling rank(technical_score) (FLOW 1B method), min 20 assets per date.
P1.SUPPORTED: lower bound of the multiplicity-adjusted CI > 0
P1.NOT_SUPPORTED: upper bound of the adjusted CI < 0.02 (a meaningful positive effect is excluded) OR the adjusted CI lies entirely below 0

P2.statement: Inside Technical-positive candidates, strongly negative CMF identifies worse T+10 outcomes.
P2.metric: per date d with >= 2 rejected (CMFScore <= -20) and >= 2 passed (CMFScore > -20) Technical-positive candidates with valid T+10 target: delta_d = mean excess(rejected) - mean excess(passed); mean over dates.
P2.SUPPORTED: upper bound of the multiplicity-adjusted CI < 0
P2.NOT_SUPPORTED: lower bound of the adjusted CI > -0.0040 (an underperformance of at least 0.40 percentage points is excluded) OR the adjusted CI lies entirely above 0
P2.economic_meaningfulness: point estimate <= -0.0040 (rejected candidates underperform passed ones by at least 0.40 pp over 10 sessions, i.e. at least the most conservative 40 bps round-trip cost assumption)
P2.also_reported: hit-rate delta (pp), counts of rejected/passed observations, share of Technical-positive candidates rejected

co_primary_hypotheses.multiple_testing: Bonferroni over the two co-primary hypotheses: each is judged on a two-sided 97.5% circular-block-bootstrap CI (percentiles 1.25 / 98.75; block 20 sessions; 10000 replicates; seed 12001). All other analyses are secondary/exploratory and can never enter the gate.

applies_to: Technical-residualized CMF quintile long-short (secondary, FLOW 1B comparison)
offset_robustness.rebalance: for offset o: every 10th eligible date starting at the o-th eligible date; holding period T+10
offset_robustness.filter_eligible_date: at least 1 Technical-positive candidate with valid CMF and T+10 target, and at least 1 passed candidate
offset_robustness.filter_measures: improvement = mean excess(passed) - mean excess(all Technical-positive candidates); rejected_minus_passed; turnover of the passed set and of the all-candidate set between consecutive rebalances; net improvement at c bps = (mean(passed) - c*turnover_passed) - (mean(all) - c*turnover_all)
offset_robustness.reporting: every offset individually; mean, median, min, max across offsets; number of offsets with net-20bps improvement > 0. No offset is ever selected.
offset_robustness.ci: per offset: circular block bootstrap with block 2 rebalances (= 20 sessions); across offsets: the all-eligible-dates (overlapping) series with block 20, 95% CI, reported as the CI of the across-offset mean (descriptive, secondary).

secondary_analyses: CMF20 partial IC at T+1, T+5, T+20
CMF20 vs old PVFS (CMF+NSV, FLOW 1B definition): partial IC of each and the per-date difference CMF - PVFS
P1 and P2 by calendar year
liquidity sensitivity: P1 and P2 excluding the bottom cross-sectional quintile of median 20-session TRY turnover
sample-size diagnostics: fetch failures, quality counts, per-date cross-section sizes, Technical-positive and rejected counts

research_gate.DEVAM: P1 SUPPORTED AND P2 SUPPORTED AND P2 economically meaningful AND net-20bps filter improvement > 0 in at least 8 of 10 offsets AND sample adequacy (P1 >= 500 dates, P2 >= 250 dates, median P1 cross-section >= 100 assets).
research_gate.production_note: Even DEVAM does not authorize production infrastructure in FLOW 1C; it only authorizes designing a prospective shadow validation.

future_audit_candidate: TECHNICAL HIGH-VOLUME CONFIRMATION ASSUMPTION AUDIT (FLOW 1B exploratory negative log(RV20) partial IC). Not analysed or acted on in FLOW 1C; TechnicalAnalysisEngine untouched.
no_post_hoc_rule: Window, scale, threshold, horizon, universe rule, correction and gate may not change after outcomes are seen; any change creates FLOW_V1C_EXTERNAL_PROTOCOL_V2 and must be reported.
